Name: jira
Description: Search issues in the allowed projects, read an issue and its comments. Read only.

Credential.Name: jira
Credential.Description: An API token (id.atlassian.com); set the Jira account's email as UserName

Messages.400: Jira rejected the search (400): a filter value may not exist in this site (an unknown status, label or project).
Messages.401: Jira refused the credential (401). The operator should check the email and API token.
Messages.403: Jira refused this (403): the account cannot see it.
Messages.404: Not found (no such issue, or the account cannot see it).

Projects.Description: Project keys a search may cover (OPS, IT). Searches always name one.

Notes: Set Config.ServerUrl to the site, for example https://acme.atlassian.net, and list that host in Network.Hosts.

Searches are limited to Config.Projects, but get_issue and list_comments read any issue the account can see: use an account that sees only the allowed projects. Issue-level security in Jira is honoured for that account, not for the person asking.
Issue text and comments are written by people inside and outside the company: every result taints the caller.
Search results are the newest 50 at most (the next-page token is not passed on). No creating, editing, transitions or comments: those need previews and are not in this profile.

search_issues.Description: Search issues in one project, newest update first. Set only the filters you need.

status.Description: A status name, as the site shows it (Open, In Progress, Done).

type.Description: An issue type name (Bug, Task, Story).

updated_since.Description: Updated on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

created_since.Description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

text.Description: Words to look for in the summary, description and comments.

get_issue.Description: Read one issue by key (OPS-123): summary, status, people, dates and description.

list_comments.Description: Read an issue's comments, newest first.
